40020173.author: पदार्थः
40020173.content: कस्यचित् of some, तु indeed, अथ then, कालस्य time, सुमाली Sumali, नाम named, राक्षसः demon, रसातलात् from Rasatala (the netherworld), मर्त्यलोकं to the mortal world, सर्वं all, वै indeed, विचचार wandered, ह (an emphatic particle).

40020173.author: Translation
40020173.content: Then, after some time, a demon named Sumali wandered throughout the entire mortal world, having come from Rasatala.

40020174.author: पदार्थः
40020174.content: नीलजीमूतसङ्काशः resembling a dark cloud, तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः wearing earrings of molten gold, कन्यां daughter, दुहितरं (his) daughter, गृह्य taking, विना without, पद्मम् a lotus, इव like, श्रियम् Lakshmi.

40020174.author: Translation
40020174.content: He, resembling a dark cloud and adorned with earrings of molten gold, took his daughter, who was as beautiful as Lakshmi without her lotus.

40020175.author: पदार्थः
40020175.content: राक्षसेन्द्रः the king of demons, सः he, तु indeed, तदा then, विचरन् wandering, वै indeed, महीतलम् on the earth's surface, तदा then, अपश्यत् saw, सः he, गच्छन्तं going, पुष्पकेण by the Pushpaka (aerial chariot), धनेश्वरम् the lord of wealth (Kubera).

40020175.author: Translation
40020175.content: While the king of demons was wandering on the surface of the earth, he then saw Kubera, the lord of wealth, traveling in the Pushpaka chariot.

40020176.author: पदार्थः
40020176.content: गच्छन्तं going, पितरं father, द्रष्टुं to see, पुलस्त्यतनयं son of Pulastya (Kubera), विभुम् the powerful one, तं him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अमरसङ्काशं resembling an immortal, स्वच्छन्दं moving freely, तपनोपमम् resembling the sun.

40020176.author: Translation
40020176.content: Having seen him, the powerful son of Pulastya (Kubera), who was going to see his father, resembling an immortal, moving freely, and radiant like the sun.

40020177.author: पदार्थः
40020177.content: रसातलं to Rasatala, प्रविष्टः having entered, सन् being, मर्त्यलोकात् from the mortal world, सविस्मयः with wonder, इति thus, एवं in this manner, चिन्तयामास thought, राक्षसानां of the demons, महामतिः the great-minded one (Sumali).

40020177.author: Translation
40020177.content: Having returned to Rasatala from the mortal world, the great-minded Sumali, filled with wonder, began to ponder in this manner.

40020178.author: पदार्थः
40020178.content: किं what, कृतं done, श्रेयः good, इति thus, एवं in this manner, वर्धेमहि may we prosper, कथं how, वयम् we, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, सुतां to his daughter, रक्षः the Rakshasa, कैकसीं Kaikasi, नाम named, नामतः by name.

40020178.author: Translation
40020178.content: The Rakshasa then spoke to his daughter, Kaikasi by name, pondering how they might prosper and what good they should do.

40020179.author: पदार्थः
40020179.content: पुत्रि O daughter, प्रदानकालः time for giving in marriage, अयम् this, यौवनं youth, व्यतिवर्तते is passing away, प्रत्याख्यानात् from rejection, च and, भीतैः by those who are afraid, त्वं you, न not, वरैः by suitors, प्रतिगृह्यसे are accepted.

40020179.author: Translation
40020179.content: O daughter, this is the time for your marriage, and your youth is passing; you are not being accepted by suitors, who are afraid of rejection.

40020180.author: पदार्थः
40020180.content: त्वत्कृते for your sake, च and, वयं we, सर्वे all, यन्त्रिताः troubled, धर्मबुद्धयः righteous-minded, त्वं you, हि indeed, सर्वगुणोपेता endowed with all virtues, श्रीः goddess of fortune, साक्षात् directly, इव as if, पुत्रिके O daughter, कन्यापितृत्वं fatherhood of a daughter, दुःखं sorrow, हि indeed, सर्वेषां for all, मानकाङ्क्षिणाम् those desiring honor.

40020180.author: Translation
40020180.content: For your sake, all of us, though righteous-minded, are troubled, for you, O daughter, are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; indeed, the fatherhood of a daughter is a sorrow for all who desire honor.

40020181.author: पदार्थः
40020181.content: न not, ज्ञायते is known, च and, कः who, कन्यां the daughter, वरयेत् would choose, इति thus, कन्यके O daughter.

40020181.author: Translation
40020181.content: And it is not known, O daughter, who would choose to marry such a maiden.

40020182.author: पदार्थः
40020182.content: त्वं you, हि indeed, सर्वगुणोपेता endowed with all virtues, श्रीः goddess of fortune, साक्षात् directly, इव as if, पुत्रिके O daughter, मातुः of the mother, कुलं family, पितृकुलं father's family, यत्र where, च and, एव indeed, प्रदीयते is given, कुलत्रयं three families, सदा always, कन्या a daughter, संशये in doubt, स्थाप्य having placed, तिष्ठति remains.

40020182.author: Translation
40020182.content: O daughter, you are indeed endowed with all virtues, like the goddess Shri herself; a daughter always keeps three families—her mother's, her father's, and the one to which she is given—in a state of uncertainty.

40020183.author: पदार्थः
40020183.content: सा she, त्वं you, मुनिवरं the best of sages, श्रेष्ठं excellent, प्रजापतिकुलोद्भवम् born in the lineage of Prajapati, भज resort to, विश्रवसं Vishravas, पुत्रि O daughter, पौलस्त्यं son of Pulastya, वरय choose, स्वयम् yourself.

40020183.author: Translation
40020183.content: O daughter, you yourself should choose and resort to Vishravas, the excellent and best of sages, born in the lineage of Prajapati and son of Pulastya.

40020184.author: पदार्थः
40020184.content: ईदृशाः such, ते your, भविष्यन्ति will be, पुत्राः sons, पुत्रि O daughter, न not, संशयः doubt, तेजसा by splendor, भास्करसमः equal to the sun, यादृशः like whom, अयं this, धनेश्वरः lord of wealth.

40020184.author: Translation
40020184.content: O daughter, without a doubt, your sons will be like this lord of wealth (Kubera), equal to the sun in splendor.

40020185.author: पदार्थः
40020185.content: सा she, तु indeed, तद्वचनं that word, श्रुत्वा having heard, कन्यका the maiden, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for her father, तत्र there, उपागम्य having approached, सा she, तस्थौ stood, विश्रवाः Vishravas, यत्र where, तप्यते was performing penance.

40020185.author: Translation
40020185.content: Having heard that instruction, the maiden, out of respect for her father, approached the place where Vishravas was performing penance and stood there.

40020186.author: पदार्थः
40020186.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राम O Rama, पुलस्त्यतनयः son of Pulastya, द्विजः the brahmin, अग्निहोत्रं the fire sacrifice, उपातिष्ठत् performed, चतुर्थः fourth, इव like, पावकः fire.

40020186.author: Translation
40020186.content: O Rama, in the meantime, the brahmin Vishravas, son of Pulastya, performed the Agnihotra ritual, appearing like a fourth sacred fire himself.

40020187.author: पदार्थः
40020187.content: अविचिन्त्य not considering, तु indeed, तां that, वेलां time, दारुणां dreadful, पितृगौरवात् out of respect for her father, उपसृत्य having approached, अग्रतः in front of, तस्य his, चरणाधोमुखी with face bowed towards his feet, स्थिता stood, विलिखन्ती scratching, मुहुः repeatedly, भूमिं the ground, अङ्गुष्ठाग्रेण with the tip of her big toe, भामिनी the beautiful woman.

40020187.author: Translation
40020187.content: Disregarding that dreadful time, out of respect for her father, the beautiful maiden approached and stood before him, her face bowed towards his feet, repeatedly scratching the ground with the tip of her big toe.

40020188.author: पदार्थः
40020188.content: सः He, तु indeed, ताम् her, वीक्ष्य having seen, सुश्रोणीम् one with beautiful hips, पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् one whose face resembles the full moon, अब्रवीत् spoke, परमोदारो the most noble (sage), दीप्यमानाम् shining, स्वतेजसा with her own radiance

40020188.author: Translation
40020188.content: The exceedingly noble sage, having seen her, who had beautiful hips, a face like the full moon, and was shining with her own radiance, spoke to her.

40020189.author: पदार्थः
40020189.content: भद्रे O auspicious one, कस्यासि whose are you, दुहिता daughter, कुतो from where, वा or, त्वम् you, इह here, आगता have come, किम् what, कार्यम् purpose, कस्य for what, वा or, हेतोः reason, तत्त्वतः truly, ब्रूहि tell, शोभने O beautiful one

40020189.author: Translation
40020189.content: O gentle lady, whose daughter are you, and from where have you come here; O beautiful one, tell me truly what your purpose is or for what reason you are here.

40020190.author: पदार्थः
40020190.content: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा she, कन्या the maiden, कृताञ्जलिः having made a respectful gesture with folded hands, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke, आत्मप्रभावेण by your own spiritual power, मुने O sage, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि you ought, मे my, मतम् intention

40020190.author: Translation
40020190.content: Thus addressed, the maiden, having folded her hands, then spoke, saying, "O sage, you are capable of knowing my intention by your own spiritual power."

40020191.author: पदार्थः
40020191.content: किम् but, तु indeed, माम् me, विद्धि know, ब्रह्मर्षे O Brahmarshi, शासनात् by the command, पितुः of my father, आगताम् having come, कैकसी Kaikasi, नाम named, नाम्ना by name, अहम् I, शेषम् the rest, त्वम् you, ज्ञातुम् to know, अर्हसि you ought

40020191.author: Translation
40020191.content: "But know me, O Brahmarshi, as one who has come by the command of my father; I am named Kaikasi by name, and you are capable of knowing the rest."

40020192.author: पदार्थः
40020192.content: सः He, तु indeed, गत्वा having gone, मुनिः the sage, ध्यानम् into meditation, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed, विज्ञातम् known, ते your, मया by me, भद्रे O auspicious one, कारणम् the reason, यत् which, मनोगतम् residing in the mind

40020192.author: Translation
40020192.content: The sage, having then entered into meditation, spoke these words: "O gentle lady, the reason that was in your mind has been known by me."

40020193.author: पदार्थः
40020193.content: सुताभिलाषो desire for a son, मत्तः from me, ते your, मत्तमातङ्गगामिनि O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, दारुणायां terrible, तु indeed, वेलायां at the time, यस्मात् because, त्वं you, माम् me, उपस्थिता approached.

40020193.author: Translation
40020193.content: O you who walk like an intoxicated elephant, since you have approached me at this dreadful time with a desire for a son from me.

40020194.author: पदार्थः
40020194.content: शृणु listen, तस्मात् therefore, सुतान् sons, भद्रे O auspicious one, यादृशान् of what kind, जनयिष्यसि you will give birth to, दारुणान् terrible, दारुणाकारान् of dreadful appearance, दारुणाभिजनप्रियान् fond of cruel deeds.

40020194.author: Translation
40020194.content: Therefore, O auspicious one, listen to the kind of sons you will give birth to: they will be terrible, of dreadful appearance, and fond of cruel deeds.

40020195.author: पदार्थः
40020195.content: प्रसविष्यसि you will give birth to, सुश्रोणि O lady with beautiful hips, राक्षसान् demons, क्रूरकर्मणः of cruel deeds, सा she, तु but, तद्वचनं his words, श्रुत्वा having heard, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words.

40020195.author: Translation
40020195.content: O lady with beautiful hips, you will give birth to Rakshasas who perform cruel deeds; but she, having heard his words, bowed down and spoke.

40020196.author: पदार्थः
40020196.content: भगवन् O venerable one, ईदृशान् such, पुत्रान् sons, त्वत्तः from you, अहं I, ब्रह्मवादिनः O speaker of Brahman, नेच्छामि do not desire, सुदुराचारान् extremely ill-behaved, प्रसादं favor, कर्तुम् to do, अर्हसि you ought.

40020196.author: Translation
40020196.content: O venerable one, O speaker of Brahman, I do not desire such extremely ill-behaved sons from you; please show me your grace.

40020197.author: पदार्थः
40020197.content: कन्यया by the maiden, तु indeed, एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तु indeed, विश्रवा Vishrava, मुनिपुङ्गवः foremost among sages, उवाच spoke, कैकसीं to Kaikasi, भूयः again, पूर्णेन्दुः the full moon, इव like, रोहिणीम् to Rohini.

40020197.author: Translation
40020197.content: But Vishrava, the foremost among sages, thus spoken to by the maiden, spoke again to Kaikasi, just as the full moon speaks to Rohini.

40020198.author: पदार्थः
40020198.content: पश्चिमो the last one, यः who, तव your, सुतः son, भविष्यति will be, शुभानने O fair-faced one, मम my, वंशानुरूपः suitable to the lineage, सः he, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, च and, भविष्यति will be.

40020198.author: Translation
40020198.content: O fair-faced one, your last son will be worthy of my lineage and will be righteous.

40020199.author: पदार्थः
40020199.content: एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु indeed, सा that, कन्या maiden, राम O Rama, कालेन by time, केनचित् by some, जनयामास gave birth to, बीभत्सं repulsive, रक्षोरूपं having the form of a Rakshasa, सुदारुणम् very terrible.

40020199.author: Translation
40020199.content: O Rama, that maiden, thus addressed, after some time gave birth to a repulsive and very terrible Rakshasa-shaped child.

40020200.author: पदार्थः
40020200.content: दशग्रीवं having ten necks, महादंष्ट्रं having great fangs, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् resembling a heap of blue collyrium, ताम्रोष्ठं having copper-red lips, विंशतिभुजं having twenty arms, महास्यं having a huge mouth, दीप्तमूर्धजम् having blazing hair.

40020200.author: Translation
40020200.content: The child had ten necks, great fangs, resembled a heap of blue collyrium, possessed copper-red lips, twenty arms, a huge mouth, and blazing hair.

40020201.author: पदार्थः
40020201.content: तस्मिन् when he, जाते was born, तु indeed, तत्काले at that very time, सज्वालकवलाः having mouthfuls of flames, शिवाः jackals, क्रव्यादाः flesh-eaters, च and, अपसव्यानि inauspicious, मण्डलानि circles, प्रचक्रमुः moved around.

40020201.author: Translation
40020201.content: At the very moment of his birth, jackals with flaming mouths and other carnivorous animals moved in inauspicious anti-clockwise circles.

40020202.author: पदार्थः
40020202.content: ववर्ष rained, रुधिरं blood, देवः the god, मेघाः clouds, च and, खरनिःस्वनाः roaring loudly, प्रबभौ shone, न not, च and, सूर्यः the sun, वै indeed, महोल्काः great meteors, च and, आपतन् fell, भुवि on the earth.

40020202.author: Translation
40020202.content: The sky rained blood, clouds roared harshly, the sun did not shine, and great meteors fell upon the earth.

40020203.author: पदार्थः
40020203.content: चकम्पे trembled, जगती the earth, चैव and, ववुः blew, वाताः winds, सुदारुणाः very fierce, अक्षोभ्यः unagitated, क्षुभितश्चैव and became agitated, समुद्रः the ocean, सरितां पतिः lord of rivers.

40020203.author: Translation
40020203.content: The earth trembled, very fierce winds blew, and even the unshakeable ocean, the lord of rivers, became agitated.

40020204.author: पदार्थः
40020204.content: अथ then, नामाकरोत् named, तस्य his, पितामहसमः like his grandfather, पिता father, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, प्रसूतो ऽयम् this one born, दशग्रीवः ten-necked, भविष्यति will be.

40020204.author: Translation
40020204.content: Then his father, who was like his grandfather (Brahma), named him Daśagrīva, declaring that this newborn would indeed be Daśagrīva (ten-necked).

40020205.author: पदार्थः
40020205.content: तस्य his, तु indeed, अनन्तरम् subsequently, जातः was born, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलः immensely powerful, प्रमाणात् in measure, यस्य whose, विपुलम् vast, प्रमाणम् measure, न not, इह here, विद्यते exists.

40020205.author: Translation
40020205.content: After him, the immensely powerful Kumbhakarna was born, whose vast size and measure had no equal in this world.

40020206.author: पदार्थः
40020206.content: ततः then, शूर्पणखा Shurpanakha, नाम named, सञ्जज्ञे was born, विकृतानना with a deformed face, विभीषणश्च and Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, कैकस्याः of Kaikasi, पश्चिमः last, सुतः son.

40020206.author: Translation
40020206.content: Then Shurpanakha, named for her deformed face, was born, followed by Vibhishana, the righteous-souled last son of Kaikasi.

40020207.author: पदार्थः
40020207.content: तस्मिन् when he, जाते was born, महासत्त्वे the great being, पुष्पवर्षम् a shower of flowers, पपात fell, ह indeed.

40020207.author: Translation
40020207.content: Indeed, when that great being (Vibhishana) was born, a shower of flowers fell.

40020208.author: पदार्थः
40020208.content: नभःस्थाने in the sky, दुन्दुभयो drums, देवानां of the gods, प्राणदंस्तदा then sounded, वाक्यं a voice, चैव and also, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, च and, साधु साध्विति "Excellent! Excellent!", तत् that, तदा then.

40020208.author: Translation
40020208.content: Then, drums of the gods sounded in the sky, and a voice from the heavens exclaimed, "Excellent! Excellent!"

40020209.author: पदार्थः
40020209.content: तौ those two, तु indeed, तत्र there, महारण्ये in the great forest, ववृधाते grew up, महौजसौ very powerful, कुम्भकर्णदशग्रीवौ Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, लोकोद्वेगकरौ causing distress to the world, तदा then.

40020209.author: Translation
40020209.content: Then, those two, Kumbhakarna and Dashagriva, grew up in that great forest, becoming exceedingly powerful and a cause of distress to the world.

40020210.author: पदार्थः
40020210.content: कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रमत्तस्तु but reckless, महर्षीन् great sages, धर्मवत्सलान् devoted to dharma, त्रैलोक्यं the three worlds, भक्षयन् devouring, नित्य always, असन्तुष्टो unsatisfied, विचचार roamed, ह indeed.

40020210.author: Translation
40020210.content: Kumbhakarna, reckless and ever unsatisfied, roamed about, devouring great sages devoted to dharma and causing havoc in the three worlds.

40020211.author: पदार्थः
40020211.content: विभीषणस्तु but Vibhishana, धर्मात्मा righteous-souled, नित्यं always, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थितः established, स्वाध्यायनियताहार with self-study and controlled diet, उवास lived, विजितेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.

40020211.author: Translation
40020211.content: In contrast, Vibhishana, a righteous soul, always remained steadfast in dharma, living with self-study, a controlled diet, and mastery over his senses.

40020212.author: पदार्थः
40020212.content: अथ then, वैश्रवणो Vaishravana, देवः the god, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, आगतः came, पितरं father, द्रष्टुं to see, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka (chariot), धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.

40020212.author: Translation
40020212.content: Then, after some time, the god Vaishravana, the lord of wealth, came there in his Pushpaka chariot to see his father.

40020213.author: पदार्थः
40020213.content: तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, कैकसी Kaikasi, तत्र there, ज्वलन्तम् shining, इव as if, तेजसा with splendor, आगम्य having come, राक्षसी the demoness, तत्र there, दशग्रीवम् to Dashagriva, उवाच said, ह indeed

40020213.author: Translation
40020213.content: Having seen him (Kubera) shining with splendor there, Kaikasi, the demoness, came to Dashagriva (Ravana) and indeed spoke to him.

40020214.author: पदार्थः
40020214.content: पुत्र O son, वैश्रवणम् Vaishravana, पश्य behold, भ्रातरम् your brother, तेजसा with splendor, वृतम् endowed, भ्रातृभावे in brotherhood, समे equal, च and, अपि even, पश्य behold, आत्मानम् yourself, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् such

40020214.author: Translation
40020214.content: "O son, behold your brother Vaishravana, endowed with splendor, and even though you are equal in brotherhood, behold yourself in such a state."

40020215.author: पदार्थः
40020215.content: दशग्रीव O Dashagriva, तथा thus, यत्नम् effort, कुरुष्व make, अमितविक्रम O one of immeasurable valor, यथा so that, त्वम् you, असि are, मे my, पुत्र son, भव become, वैश्रवणोपमः equal to Vaishravana

40020215.author: Translation
40020215.content: "O Dashagriva, O one of immeasurable valor, make such an effort, my son, so that you become equal to Vaishravana."

40020216.author: पदार्थः
40020216.content: मातुः of the mother, तत् that, वचनम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, प्रतापवान् valorous, अमर्षम् indignation, अतुलम् unequalled, लेभे obtained, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, च and, अकरोत् made, तदा then

40020216.author: Translation
40020216.content: Having heard that speech of his mother, the valorous Dashagriva felt unequalled indignation and then made a vow.

40020217.author: पदार्थः
40020217.content: सत्यम् truly, ते to you, प्रतिजानामि I promise, भ्रातृतुल्यः equal to brother, अधिकः superior, अपि even, वा or, भविष्यामि I shall become, ओजसा with might, च and, एव indeed, सन्तापम् sorrow, त्यज abandon, हृद्गतम् residing in the heart

40020217.author: Translation
40020217.content: "Truly, I promise you that I shall become either equal to or even superior to my brother in might; therefore, abandon the sorrow residing in your heart."

40020218.author: पदार्थः
40020218.content: ततः then, तेनैव by that very, कोपेन anger, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, चिकीर्षुः desiring to do, दुष्करं difficult, कर्म deed, तपसे for penance, धृतमानसः with a mind set

40020218.author: Translation
40020218.content: Then, filled with that very anger, Dashagriva, along with his younger brothers, set his mind on performing a difficult penance.

40020219.author: पदार्थः
40020219.content: प्राप्स्यामि I shall obtain, तपसा through penance, कामम् my desire, इति thus, कृत्वा having thought, अध्यवस्य having resolved, च and, आगच्छत् he came, आत्मसिद्ध्यर्थं for the accomplishment of his own purpose, गोकर्णस्य of Gokarna, आश्रमं hermitage, शुभम् auspicious

40020219.author: Translation
40020219.content: Having resolved that he would achieve his desires through penance, he then came to the auspicious hermitage of Gokarna for the accomplishment of his own purpose.

40020220.author: पदार्थः
40020220.content: सः that, राक्षसः demon, तत्र there, सहानुजः with his younger brothers, तदा then, तपश्चकार performed penance, अतुलम् incomparable, उग्रविक्रमः of fierce prowess, अतोषयत् he pleased, च and, अपि also, पितामहं the grandfather (Brahma), विभुं the lord, ददौ he gave, सः he, तुष्टः pleased, च and, वरान् boons, जयावहान् bringing victory

40020220.author: Translation
40020220.content: That demon of fierce prowess, along with his younger brothers, then performed incomparable penance there, and he also pleased the lord Brahma, who, being pleased, granted him boons that brought victory. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे नवमः सर्गः ।। 9 ।। Thus ends the ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
